# meltcloud_nest_instance (Resource)

A [Nest Instance](https://docs.meltcloud.io/concepts/nest) is one machine of the Nest. Adding one builds its install ISO: boot the machine from it, and it installs and joins the Nest. Creating the resource waits until the ISO is built, not until the instance has joined; `status` turns from `installing` to `ready` once it has.

Needs the API Key of the admin Organization. A Nest has at most seven instances, and adds one at a time.

~> A Nest Instance cannot be removed yet, so destroying or replacing one fails.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# add a second and a third nest instance, each in a zone of its own
resource "meltcloud_nest_instance" "nest_1" {
  name    = "nest-1"
  ip      = "10.0.10.11"
  zone_id = meltcloud_zone.zrh_dc2.id

  install_disk_device = "/dev/disk/by-id/nvme-SAMSUNG_MZQL2960HCJR-00A07_S64FNE0R123456"
}

resource "meltcloud_nest_instance" "nest_2" {
  name    = "nest-2"
  ip      = "10.0.10.12"
  zone_id = meltcloud_zone.zrh_dc3.id

  # a nest adds one instance at a time
  depends_on = [meltcloud_nest_instance.nest_1]
}

# boot each machine from its ISO, for example through its BMC
output "nest_1_iso" {
  value     = meltcloud_nest_instance.nest_1.url_iso_amd64
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip` (String) The address the instance gets on the Nest's primary host network, from that network's IP Pool
- `name` (String) Name of the Nest Instance, unique within the Nest
- `zone_id` (Number) ID of the [Zone](https://docs.meltcloud.io/concepts/regions-and-zones) the instance is in. Sets the Kubernetes labels `topology.kubernetes.io/region` and `topology.kubernetes.io/zone` on its node

### Optional

- `etcd_disk` (Boolean) Keep etcd on a disk of its own
- `etcd_disk_device` (String) Device etcd is kept on
- `etcd_disk_mirror` (Boolean) Mirror the etcd disk
- `etcd_disk_mirror_device` (String) Device the etcd disk is mirrored to
- `install_disk_device` (String) Device the instance installs to, for example `/dev/sda`. Leave it out to let the installer pick
- `install_disk_mirror` (Boolean) Mirror the install disk
- `install_disk_mirror_device` (String) Device the install disk is mirrored to

### Read-Only

- `architecture` (String) CPU architecture the instance reported once it booted
- `id` (Number) Internal ID of the Nest Instance on meltcloud
- `nest_id` (Number) ID of the Nest the instance belongs to
- `status` (String) Status of the instance: `installing` until it has joined the Nest, then `ready`
- `url_iso_amd64` (String, Sensitive) URL of the install ISO for amd64 machines. It carries a download token
- `url_iso_arm64` (String, Sensitive) URL of the install ISO for arm64 machines. It carries a download token
- `version` (String) Nest version the instance runs

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import meltcloud_nest_instance.nest_1 nest_instances/2
```
